title: [autoneg]When advertise interface type is set, disabling AN, setting interface type and re-enabling autoneg will lead to port oper down
author: dgsudharsan
body:

#### Description
Since the interface type is set only when AN is enabled as seen [here](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/blob/a01470f8eb210bdab462cdcaefc3471a9f8f9d0b/orchagent/portsorch.cpp#L3587
) it leads to stale configs present when AN is re-enabled. With mismatching interface type vs advertised interface types vendor SAI can throw errors as shown below.


<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Configure autoneg, interface type and advertise interface type
2. Disable Autoneg.
3.  Modify interface type, advertise interface type
4. Enable autoneg

#### Describe the results you received:
Enable autoneg throws error in syslog and not reflected in ASIC_DB. Port is in down state

#### Describe the results you expected:
Autoneg should succeed.

linkedPullRequests.title: [autoneg]Fixing adv interface types to be set when AN is disabled
linkedPullRequests.author: dgsudharsan
linkedPullRequests.body:
<!--
Please make sure you have read and understood the contribution guildlines:
https://github.com/Azure/SONiC/blob/gh-pages/CONTRIBUTING.md

1. Make sure your commit includes a signature generted with `git commit -s`
2. Make sure your commit title follows the correct format: [component]: description
3. Make sure your commit message contains enough details about the change and related tests
4. Make sure your pull request adds related reviewers, asignees, labels

Please also provide the following information in this pull request:
-->

**What I did**
Allowing advertised interface types to be set even when AN is disabled. The SAI header doesn't restrict this field. In some cases when this field is changed during AN disable, it may not be reflected in SAI leading to errors as seen in the issue below. This will occur when interface type mismatches with advertise interface type and the vendor SAI library has checks.


**Why I did it**
To fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/13414

**How I verified it**
Added UT to verify


**Details if related**

comments.author: liat-grozovik
comments.body: @prgeor  could you please help to review?

comments.author: prgeor
comments.body: > @dgsudharsan we need to update [HLD](https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/blame/master/doc/port_auto_neg/port-auto-negotiation-design.md#L224). Now that we allow changing interface adv type even if AN=disabled

comments.author: dgsudharsan
comments.body: > > @dgsudharsan we need to update [HLD](https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/blame/master/doc/port_auto_neg/port-auto-negotiation-design.md#L224). > > Now that we allow changing interface adv type even if AN=disabled > > Hi @prgeor I believe even previously we did the same. The HLD captures the behavior correctly. We accept the advertised-interface type even without AN enabled but that will be effective only when AN is turned on. We previously didn't block.
